ranked_facts.why: The presence of intradermal neutrophilic inflammation with ulceration and intracorneal neutrophils is more characteristic of IBD-Associated Neutrophilic Dermatosis and Sweet's Syndrome than of Systemic Vasculitis or Infectious Process.

The finding of moderate inflammation, edema, erosions, and pseudopolyps in the sigmoid colon is more typical of Ulcerative Colitis and IBD-Associated Neutrophilic Dermatosis than of Neutrophilic Dermatosis, Systemic Vasculitis, or Infectious Process.
